categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: Great Southern Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) manufacturing, Great Health industry (beverages, food, healthcare products), Great Commerce (pharmaceutical distribution including wholesale, retail, import and export), and Great Medical Care (medical services, health management, elderly care, and medical devices). It has a comprehensive industrial chain covering R&D, manufacturing, sales, and healthcare services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs GMP-compliant pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, centralized procurement platforms for raw materials including GAP-certified herbal bases, and advanced quality control systems. It integrates traditional Chinese medicine production with modern chemical medicine and biosimilars, utilizing technologies such as supercritical CO2 extraction, chromatographic fingerprinting, and digital quality management tools. The company also capitalizes on digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include medium and large hospitals, pharmaceutical wholesalers, distributors, retailers, and end consumers in the healthcare and beverage sectors. The company serves markets across China with a focus on Southern China and expanding presence in Eastern, Northern, North-Eastern, South-Western, and North-Western China, as well as international markets including Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and overseas expansion.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with a strong presence in Southern China, Guangdong Province, and the Greater Bay Area. It also has operations and market penetration in Eastern, Northern, North-Eastern, South-Western, and North-Western China. Overseas assets and international expansion efforts are ongoing, including markets in Macau and other international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire pharmaceutical supply chain, including upstream raw material cultivation and procurement, midstream pharmaceutical manufacturing and R&D, and downstream pharmaceutical distribution, retail, and healthcare services. It has integrated forward and backward supply chain operations, including centralized procurement platforms and extensive distribution networks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the pharmaceutical manufacturing supply chain, enhancing R&D capabilities with over 200 candidate projects including innovative drugs and biosimilars, expanding digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing, and accelerating internationalization. The company focuses on innovation in TCM, generic drug consistency evaluation, and development of specialty active pharmaceutical ingredients. It also emphasizes sustainable development and capital operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals (Chinese patent medicine, chemical medicine, biological medicine), healthcare products, and beverages. Additional revenue streams include pharmaceutical wholesale and retail distribution, import and export business, medical services, and health industry investments. The company also benefits from government grants and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest pharmaceutical enterprises in China, holding a leading position especially in Southern China and the TCM sector. It competes with major pharmaceutical companies such as China National Medicines Co., Ltd., Shanghai Pharmaceuticals Holding Co., Ltd., Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical Group, Beijing Tongrentang, and Yunnan Baiyao Group. The company emphasizes its strong brand portfolio, comprehensive product range, and integrated supply chain as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 75 billion with a slight year-on-year decrease of 0.69%. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.835 billion, down 30.09% year-on-year. Total assets were about RMB 81.68 billion with net assets of RMB 35.9 billion. The company maintains a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in R&D and capital expenditures, and a gearing ratio around 53.76%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company leverages its rich heritage in traditional Chinese medicine, a broad and well-recognized brand portfolio including century-old brands, and a comprehensive product range covering TCM, chemical medicines, and healthcare products. It emphasizes high-quality manufacturing, innovation-driven R&D, integrated supply chain management, and digital transformation to deliver differentiated products and services. Its strong market penetration, especially in Southern China and the herbal tea segment, and commitment to sustainable development further differentiate its value proposition.
